to_five: a1 (4): hs land: merge adjacent-but-distinct markdown sections (by ## heading) in files like CONTRACTS.md automatically instead of stopping with 'real conflicts', showing the merged section boundary in the output

a2 (4): hs watch --path

--count 1 --sync should count only changesets after my synced base that are not mine and not already in my files, so it neither returns at once on my own land nor skips lands made between my sync and the start of the wait

a3 (4): hs land --item C… should say 'this closes C… (whole item); add --under C… to land a piece and keep it open' before closing an item whose title covers more than the changeset, or `hs claim --done` should be the only way to close a self-created item.
